facts.fact: Ministry of Gender, Labour and Social Development's SAGE head said the ministry had started piloting mobile money payments of the SAGE older-persons grant as an alternative to the existing payment-point system, to be extended nationwide if the pilot succeeds.

The SAGE programme head said eligible older people are refused the grant because the date of birth on their national ID card puts them below the age-80 threshold, and 43,000 complaints have been received.
